about:
Alpha Electric Supply was founded in 1987 on the island of Maui by four electrical-supply veterans with a combined 105 years of experience. The company is headquartered in Honolulu, Hawaii, and is owned by Honsador Holdings LLC and Doman Building Materials Group Ltd. Honsador, a Hawaiian business dating back to 1935, operates 15 branch locations across the islands and employs over 250 people across its family of companies.

Alpha operates as a wholesale distributor of electrical products, sourcing from a broad network of manufacturers rather than producing its own goods. Its branches on Maui, Oahu, Kauai, and the Big Island (Hilo and Kona) stock wire, conduit, lighting, circuit breakers, switchgear, photovoltaic equipment, and related materials. The company provides delivery using a fleet of vans, pickup trucks, stakebed/flatbed trucks, and heavy-duty utility trucks, and offers project pricing, credit accounts with Net 30 terms, and takeoff/quotation services from customer plans.

The supplier serves commercial, industrial, residential, utility, and photovoltaic market segments throughout Hawaii. Its customer base includes contractors, businesses, and homeowners seeking energy-efficient products, resilient power systems, and safety technologies. Alpha also supports commercial energy projects and home energy solutions through dedicated programs.

The company’s stated differentiator is a service philosophy captured in its motto: the customer is the purpose of the business, not an interruption. Alpha emphasizes that it does not private-label products, maintains market-specific inventory from qualified manufacturers, and leverages long-standing vendor relationships to secure competitive pricing and availability.
